name: MasterMatch
tagline: Real-time camera alignment checking for car-assembly stations, with a gauge for operators.

awards: Vision Alignment Tool presented by Ford

problem: Misaligned parts on an assembly line cause defects.
solution: Industrial cameras and hybrid computer vision (feature matching and template matching) compare parts with a master template to fine angular and positional precision, showing a live gauge.
demo_moment: Team-described: rotate a part and watch the gauge flag the deviation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Vision Alignment Tool presented by Ford” among 122 submissions.
